name: Garrett
description: Garrett is a wizard who aids the party in their underground operations and infiltration efforts. Capable of adapting to high-stress espionage scenarios—such as adopting disguises and navigating the treacherous sanctums of Xanathar's Lair—he brings versatile arcane support and intellectual pragmatism to the crew.
ideals: Pragmatism: 'Knowledge and adaptation are the keys to surviving hostile environments.'
Survival: 'Blend in, think quickly, and use every tool at your disposal.'
bonds: The party and their shared questing endeavors.
The pursuit of magical lore and survival in dangerous territories.
flaws: Can be caught off-guard by sudden shifts in chaotic underground environments.
speech_patterns: Calculated, intelligent, and focused, often offering tactical observations or magical solutions during missions.
mannerisms: Keeps a close watch on arcane residues, maintains composure under pressure, and utilizes magical utility when infiltrating secure areas.
motivations: To survive and successfully navigate high-stakes incursions into dangerous enemy territory.
To support the party with arcane versatility and tactical spellcasting.
knowledge: Proficiency in arcane theory, spellcasting, and utility magic.
Familiarity with covert operations, infiltration tactics, and handling magical anomalies.
gm_notes: Garrett functions as a reliable arcane asset for the party during dungeon dives, heists, and tactical infiltrations, offering flexible spellcasting and solid collaborative support.
